play.title: Canari - Mines Saint-Étienne
play.shortDescription: Encrypted messaging, clubs and agenda for student life
play.fullDescription:
Canari is an independent application developed by the Les Rootz student association for the students of École des Mines de Saint-Étienne (EMSE). It is not published by the school's administration.

It brings messaging and campus life together in one place:

• Encrypted messaging: chat one-on-one or in groups with end-to-end encryption (MLS protocol). Messages can only be read by the people in the conversation.
• Communities: find your class, your campus or your club in discussion spaces organised in channels.
• Associations: browse the directory of student associations, discover their members, manage your memberships and generate the carte de la vie asso.
• Agenda: a calendar adapted to your campus and your programme, with reminders, and an ICS subscription or a PDF export to take it into your own calendar.
• News, polls and forms: follow the associations' feed, vote, react, comment and answer forms.
• Canareels: film and share short videos with your campus.
• Shop and ticketing: book your seats and buy association products with a payment built into the app.
• Institutions: find the school and student-life bodies, and create your own right in the app.
• Photos, videos and documents: share files that are encrypted before they are even sent.

An EMSE account is required to sign in.
